notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.content:
The difficulty of the game was unfitting to a big scale of players, so to help solve this problem I created a new difficulty level "Easy".

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New difficulty level (Easy)
[/list]

To make this possible, some changes were made to the game, hopefully this will not result in creating some new bugs but if it does please inform me.

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.content:
Thank you guys for your support and feedback, the following are the changes that took place;

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased the difficulty of level 8
[*] The levels difficulty was not scaling properly, some early levels were harder than late game levels (Level 2 Specially), so some rearranging was done. Hopefully, now the player will build up his/her skills as s/he progress through the game to be able to beat the harder levels as they start appearing
[/list]

[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some players save data got corrupted after completing the game, hopefully this will no longer happen
[*] Changing the volume of the audio from the Pause Screen should be working perfectly now, unlike before
[*] The bug encountered in Level 9 regarding the credit scene has been fixed
[/list]
